Simulate a study with known variance components

Source: R/plan.R
msa_simulate.Rd

Generates numeric results of a crossed study from assumed variance components, for teaching and for planning study size with msa_plan().

Usage

msa_simulate(
  n_items,
  n_prompts,
  n_models,
  n_reps,
  n_blocks = 1,
  vc = list(item = 1, prompt = 0.05, model = 0.05, residual = 0.1),
  mean = 0,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n_items, n_prompts, n_models, n_reps, n_blocks

Design sizes.

vc

Named list of variance components: item, prompt, model, block, item_prompt, item_model, prompt_model, residual. Missing components are zero.

mean

Grand mean.

seed

Optional seed.

Value

An msa_runs data.frame with a latent column holding the item truth and the value column holding the simulated measurement.

Examples

r <- msa_simulate(20, 3, 2, 3, vc = list(item = 1, prompt = 0.05, residual = 0.1), seed = 1)
msa_grr(msa_fit(r, type = "numeric"))
#> boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
